column4: Backend foundation
column5: Python/FastAPI service skeleton, PostGIS database and migrations.

column4: Event ingestion
column5: Daily batch ingestion of Montreal open data events into PostgreSQL. See ADR 0004.

column4: REST API
column5: Read-only versioned REST API for spawns, catalog, sources and ingestion runs.

column4: Frontend integration
column5: Existing React app consumes the API while keeping demo mode working.

column4: Backend CI
column5: GitHub Actions checks for the backend with a real PostGIS service container.

column4: Atlassian setup
column5: Jira project, GitHub for Jira integration, Confluence space with architecture and ADRs.

column4: Kafka ingestion lab
column5: Separate learning implementation of the ingestion pipeline on Kafka. Not production. See ADR 0005.

column4: Scaffold backend with uv, FastAPI, Ruff, mypy and pytest
column5: Acceptance criteria: GET /health returns 200; ruff, mypy and pytest pass locally.

column4: Docker Compose with PostGIS and settings from environment
column5: Acceptance criteria: docker compose up starts PostGIS; the app reads DATABASE_URL via pydantic-settings; .env.example committed; .env gitignored.

column4: SQLAlchemy models and first Alembic migration
column5: Acceptance criteria: Tables sources, spawns, ingestion_runs; UNIQUE(source_id, external_id); GiST index on location; alembic upgrade and downgrade both work.

column4: Readiness endpoint checks the database
column5: Acceptance criteria: GET /health/ready returns 200 when the DB answers and 503 otherwise; covered by a test.

column4: Backend CI job with PostGIS service container
column5: Acceptance criteria: Workflow runs ruff, mypy, alembic upgrade head and pytest against PostGIS; fails the PR on any error.

column4: Path filters for frontend and backend CI jobs
column5: Acceptance criteria: Frontend-only changes skip the backend job and vice versa; docs-only changes run neither.

column4: Create Jira project, import roadmap, install GitHub for Jira
column5: Acceptance criteria: Project SPAWN exists with these epics and stories; a branch named with a key appears on its story.

column4: Create Confluence space with architecture page and ADRs
column5: Acceptance criteria: Space SPAWN contains the Phase 2a architecture page and ADRs 0001-0006.

column4: Download events GeoJSON and commit a small fixture
column5: Acceptance criteria: httpx client with User-Agent, timeout and retries; anonymized fixture of about 20 varied rows in tests/fixtures.

column4: Pydantic model for source rows and cleaning of missing values
column5: Acceptance criteria: The strings nan, None and empty become null; rows without coordinates or with invalid dates are rejected with a reason.

column4: Map city event categories to Spawn types
column5: Acceptance criteria: All 28 categories mapped or explicitly excluded; online events and council meetings excluded; unit tests for every category.

column4: Rarity rules from type and duration
column5: Acceptance criteria: Pure function with documented rules; unit tests for each rarity.

column4: Convert dates to all-day timestamps in America/Montreal
column5: Acceptance criteria: starts_at at 00:00 and ends_at at 23:59:59 local time; daylight saving boundaries tested.

column4: Idempotent upsert with content hash and deactivation
column5: Acceptance criteria: Running ingestion twice changes nothing the second time; rows missing from the source get is_active=false; integration tests.

column4: Record ingestion runs with counts and rejected samples
column5: Acceptance criteria: Each run writes fetched/inserted/updated/unchanged/rejected counts and status; failed runs keep existing data.

column4: CLI entry point for ingestion
column5: Acceptance criteria: python -m spawn_api.ingest --source montreal-events runs the full pipeline and prints a summary.

column4: Curated source from seed file
column5: Acceptance criteria: The 20 hand-written experiences load as source curated through the same upsert path.

column4: Nearby spawns endpoint with PostGIS distance and filters
column5: Acceptance criteria: GET /api/v1/spawns with lat, lng, radius_m, type, status, audience, free, limit, cursor; distance_m from ST_Distance; tested on PostGIS.

column4: Spawn detail endpoint with consistent 404
column5: Acceptance criteria: GET /api/v1/spawns/{id}; an unknown id returns the standard error body.

column4: Catalog endpoint for types and rarities
column5: Acceptance criteria: GET /api/v1/catalog returns labels, colors and XP matching the frontend catalog.

column4: Sources and ingestion runs endpoints
column5: Acceptance criteria: GET /api/v1/sources and GET /api/v1/ingestion-runs, read-only, paginated.

column4: Standard error format and CORS for local frontend
column5: Acceptance criteria: All errors share one JSON shape; CORS allows only the local dev origin.

column4: Generate TypeScript types from OpenAPI
column5: Acceptance criteria: An npm script generates types from the backend schema; CI fails if they are out of date.

column4: API client with loading, error states and sample-data fallback
column5: Acceptance criteria: The app loads spawns from the API; when it is unreachable, demo mode with sample data still works; existing features unchanged.

column4: All-day spawn display
column5: Acceptance criteria: All-day spawns show Today or Until <date> instead of a minute countdown; unit tests in src/lib.

column4: Show data source attribution
column5: Acceptance criteria: Attribution to Ville de Montreal open data (CC BY 4.0) is visible in the app.

column4: Build the API Docker image in CI without pushing
column5: Acceptance criteria: docker build succeeds in CI; the image is not pushed anywhere.

column4: Kafka single-broker setup with Docker Compose
column5: Acceptance criteria: KRaft broker starts locally; topics spawn.events.raw, spawn.events.normalized and spawn.events.dlq are created by a script.

column4: Kafka producer for source rows
column5: Acceptance criteria: Publishes each source row to spawn.events.raw keyed by external_id.

column4: Kafka consumer group with idempotent upsert and dead-letter topic
column5: Acceptance criteria: The consumer reuses the backend transform code; invalid rows go to the DLQ; reprocessing the same messages does not duplicate rows.

column4: Kafka lab write-up with experiments
column5: Acceptance criteria: Documents stopping and adding consumers and replaying offsets, with what was actually observed.
